name: @pipeworx/mcp-nws

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Get the 7-day NWS forecast for a US lat/lon. Returns named periods (e.g., "Tonight", "Wednesday") with high/low temperature, wind, and a short text forecast. US locations only.

tools.name: get_hourly_forecast
tools.description: Get the hourly NWS forecast for a US lat/lon (~168 hours). Useful for short-term planning, severe-weather windows, or precipitation timing.

tools.name: get_alerts
tools.description: Active NWS watches / warnings / advisories. Filter by US state (2-letter code), point (lat,lon), severity, or status. Returns event name, severity, urgency, headline, description, affected areas, and effective/expires times.

latitude.description: Latitude (use with longitude for point query)

longitude.description: Longitude (use with latitude for point query)

event.description: Restrict to a specific event type (e.g., "Tornado Warning")

tools.name: get_observation
tools.description: Latest observation from a specific NWS weather station. Returns temperature, humidity, wind, visibility, pressure, and present-weather codes.

tools.name: get_stations
tools.description: Find NWS weather observation stations in a US state (e.g., "CA", "NY", "TX"). Returns station IDs (use with get_observation), names, time zones, and coordinates. US only.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-nws forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the nws pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
